title: Hanumān Reports Laṅkā
story: After Hanumān’s return, the mission changes from search to preparation for war. Rāma asks Hanumān to describe Laṅkā in detail: its defenses, gates, forces, approaches, and the difficulty of the ocean crossing. Hanumān’s knowledge now serves the whole army. What he saw alone becomes information that others can act upon.
explore: Strategic Scene Discovery: inspect a stylized tactical view and reveal three categories Hanumān can report on — fortifications, forces, and access/crossing conditions.
interaction: Information Triage: player chooses which details are useful for Rāma’s next decision. All canonical details remain fixed; the activity teaches the difference between observation and assumption.

mastery.prompt: Why does Rāma ask Hanumān to speak about Laṅkā?
items: A. Hanumān personally observed the city
D. Hanumān has never been there
mastery.answer: A. Hanumān personally observed the city
mastery.feedback: Hanumān’s authority in this scene comes from direct reconnaissance.

mastery.prompt: Match the report category to its value:
mastery.answer: Fortifications → how Laṅkā is defended; Forces → what resistance may be faced; Ocean/access → how the army must reach the island
mastery.feedback: The reconnaissance matters because each observation supports a different military decision.

mastery.prompt: Which qualities does this encounter add to Hanumān’s profile beyond physical strength?
mastery.feedback: Hanumān’s service now includes transforming what he saw into reliable guidance for others.

unlocks: Character Knowledge: Hanumān — reconnaissance, memory, strategic communication. Connection clue: Hanumān → Rāma = Messenger + Service reinforced. No new Sacred Object.
takeaway: What Hanumān sees alone becomes knowledge that can serve everyone.
teaser: Next: Hanumān Speaks for Vibhīṣaṇa — strategy gives way to a harder question: whom can the army trust?

sourceNote: Primary source directly states that Rāma asks Hanumān to describe Laṅkā as he saw it. Keep the encounter focused on reconnaissance, not invented military tactics.

title: Hanumān Speaks for Vibhīṣaṇa
story: Vibhīṣaṇa leaves Rāvaṇa and appears with four companions, asking to take refuge with Rāma. Sugrīva and several vānar leaders are suspicious. Rāma asks for counsel. Hanumān does not dismiss the danger, but argues from Vibhīṣaṇa’s speech, expression, timing, and recognition of Rāma’s merits and Rāvaṇa’s faults. Rāma then gives his own judgment and accepts the one who comes seeking refuge.
explore: Council Scene Discovery: identify the visible signs the text itself lets Hanumān consider — speech, demeanor, timing, and stated reason for coming.
interaction: Evidence vs Fear: sort statements into textual evidence / reasonable concern / unsupported assumption. The player is not asked to 'vote' on canon.

mastery.prompt: What role does Hanumān play when Vibhīṣaṇa asks for refuge?
items: B. He gives Rāma a reasoned opinion
mastery.answer: B. He gives Rāma a reasoned opinion
mastery.feedback: Hanumān acts here as counselor, not merely as warrior.

mastery.prompt: What does Hanumān consider when judging Vibhīṣaṇa?
items: B. The timing of his arrival
C. Rāma’s merits and Rāvaṇa’s conduct as Vibhīṣaṇa sees them
D. A secret prophecy invented by Hanumān
mastery.feedback: The reasoning is observational and contextual; Hanumān does not claim certainty from supernatural knowledge.

mastery.prompt: Which relationship becomes available through this episode?
mastery.feedback: This is a different source-layer moment from the earlier Rāmacaritamānasa HJ-09 meeting. The app should preserve both without pretending they are the same event.

unlocks: Connection clue: Hanumān ↔ Vibhīṣaṇa = Alliance; Vibhīṣaṇa → Rāma = Alliance/Service. Character Knowledge: Hanumān — counsel/discernment.
takeaway: Strength can defend a camp; discernment helps decide whom the camp can trust.
teaser: Next: Crossing into Laṅkā — counsel is settled; the entire campaign must now cross the ocean.

title: Crossing into Laṅkā
story: The war cannot begin until the army reaches Laṅkā. A bridge is established across the sea, and the vānar forces cross toward the island. Hanumān is part of the advancing campaign, but the text gives the bridge-making role to Nala. Hanumān moves from the mission of one messenger to the movement of an entire army.
explore: Route Discovery: distinguish three layers on the map — Hanumān’s earlier leap route, the later Setu crossing, and Laṅkā as destination.
interaction: Chronology Challenge: place “Hanumān’s leap → report to Rāma → bridge/campaign crossing” in order.

mastery.prompt: Who is explicitly identified in the Vālmīki Yuddha Kāṇḍa as the maker/creator of the bridge?
mastery.feedback: This prevents the app from incorrectly transferring another character’s role to Hanumān.

items: A. Hanumān’s first leap to Laṅkā uses Rāma Setu
B. The Setu crossing happens later, with the army, in Yuddha Kāṇḍa
mastery.answer: B. The Setu crossing happens later, with the army, in Yuddha Kāṇḍa
mastery.feedback: The two ocean crossings belong to different moments and must remain visually distinct on the campaign map.

items: 3. Hanumān first leaps across the ocean
mastery.feedback: Keeping the chronology clear prevents the macro map from flattening different journeys into one route.

takeaway: The same ocean that Hanumān crossed alone must now be crossed by an army.
teaser: Next: Hanumān at the Western Gate — the campaign reaches Laṅkā and Hanumān takes a battlefield command position.

sourceNote: Do not present Rāmeśvaram as proof of the textual crossing. Use as traditional/modern geographic context only. Never route HJ-04 through the Setu.

title: Hanumān at the Western Gate
story: Rāvaṇa sends Dhumrākṣa with a force to attack Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, and the vānar army. Dhumrākṣa exits through Laṅkā’s western gate — the sector where Hanumān is stationed as an army-chief. The encounter shifts Hanumān’s role again: scout, messenger, and counselor are now joined by responsibility for a battlefield sector.
explore: Battlefield Orientation: identify the gate, Hanumān’s vānar position, and the incoming rākṣasa force.
interaction: Threat Reading: select the most relevant change in the scene — a named enemy commander is advancing directly into Hanumān’s sector.

mastery.prompt: At which gate is Hanumān stationed when Dhumrākṣa advances?
mastery.feedback: The source explicitly connects Dhumrākṣa’s advance with the western gate where Hanumān is stationed.

mastery.prompt: Why is this encounter different from Hanumān’s earlier Laṅkā encounters?
items: A. He is now responsible within a larger army
B. He is secretly searching alone
C. He has not met Rāma yet
D. He is carrying the ring to Sītā
mastery.answer: A. He is now responsible within a larger army
mastery.feedback: The context has changed from infiltration to open campaign leadership.

mastery.prompt: Which relation fits Dhumrākṣa and Hanumān in this battle context?
mastery.feedback: Connections should record the relationship only after the player builds it, not simply because both characters appear.

teaser: Next: Hanumān in Battle — command becomes direct protection when the vānar formation begins to break.

title: Hanumān in Battle
story: Akampana’s attack drives the vānar forces into disorder. Hanumān comes to their aid. When the other vānaras see him, they rally around him and regain confidence. Akampana rains arrows upon Hanumān, but Hanumān continues forward, ultimately striking him down. The important story beat is not simply that Hanumān wins a duel: his presence restores the courage of those around him.
explore: Battle Rally Discovery: identify the moment the vānar formation changes — scattered allies regroup around Hanumān.
interaction: Battle Sequence: rally of vānaras → Akampana attacks → Hanumān advances → duel resolved.

mastery.prompt: What happens when the vānar warriors see Hanumān come to their rescue?
mastery.feedback: His battlefield importance is relational as well as physical: his presence restores confidence.

mastery.prompt: Put the Akampana encounter in order:
items: 2. Akampana’s attack disrupts the vānar forces
mastery.feedback: The encounter teaches the battle as a rescue-and-rally story, not just a finishing blow.

mastery.prompt: What does the source support about Hanumān in this encounter?
items: A. He absorbs heavy attack and continues
B. His allies gain courage around him
mastery.feedback: Rāvaṇa’s final defeat remains Rāma’s climactic action; this encounter should not distort that shared-world structure.

unlocks: Character: Akampana. Connection challenge: Akampana → Hanumān = Opposition. Character Knowledge: Hanumān — rallying leadership, endurance, protection of allies.
takeaway: In war, Hanumān’s strength is measured by what happens to others when he arrives.
teaser: Next: Night of Crisis — the battlefield changes from combat to survival.

title: Night of Crisis
story: Indrajit’s Brahma weapon leaves Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, and vast numbers of vānar warriors incapacitated. Hanumān and Vibhīṣaṇa remain conscious. Carrying torches, they move through the devastated battlefield searching for Jāmbavān. The chapter closes with a new kind of urgency: the question is no longer how to defeat the enemy, but whether the fallen can be saved.
explore: Torchlight Scene Discovery: search the dark battlefield for Rāma, Lakṣmaṇa, surviving allies, and Jāmbavān. Keep interaction respectful and non-gory.
interaction: Rescue Priority: identify why finding Jāmbavān matters. The next canonical instruction is revealed only after the player completes the scene.

mastery.prompt: Who remains active and searches the battlefield for Jāmbavān?
mastery.feedback: The source explicitly places Hanumān and Vibhīṣaṇa searching among the wounded.

mastery.prompt: Why does this encounter naturally lead into the Mountain of Herbs chapter?
items: A. Jāmbavān will entrust Hanumān with the rescue mission
B. The war is already over
C. Hanumān returns to Kiṣkindhā permanently
D. Sītā asks for the bridge to be rebuilt
mastery.answer: A. Jāmbavān will entrust Hanumān with the rescue mission
mastery.feedback: The search for Jāmbavān is the hinge between battlefield crisis and Hanumān’s lifesaving mission.

mastery.prompt: Which roles of Hanumān are active here?
mastery.feedback: The encounter deliberately shifts away from victory imagery and shows service under conditions of uncertainty and loss.
